_comment: Weekly Wing challenges. ONE challenge for every Wing per study week —
the challenge is picked deterministically by study-week number, never
at random, so every Wing in a cohort sees the same prompt that week.
The team can edit titles, descriptions, metric choices and targets
without a code change. If the pool is empty, the Wings screen
id            unique short id (used only in logs / tests)
title         what the student sees as the headline
description   one supportive sentence under the title
target        target the Wing's combined count needs to reach
unit          singular unit word for the progress text

challenges.title: Rainbow Week
challenges.description: Everyone's veg-forward meals add up — can your Wing colour in the week together?

challenges.title: Move Together
challenges.description: Add up any movement, however small — walks between class count as much as a workout.

challenges.title: Show-Up Week
challenges.description: A quiet goal: as many days as your Wing can where someone logged something.

challenges.title: Balanced Plates
challenges.description: Any meal with a few food groups on the plate counts — collect them together.
